name: Hot Wings with Blue Cheese Dressing & Celery-Carrot Mixed Green Salad
ingredients: 2 lb chicken wings, split with tips removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 500°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and place in a large bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Transfer to the baking sheet and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until wings are cooked through, 20-25 minutes.
About 5 minutes before the wings are done, wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the celery along with carrots and dressing. Toss to combine the salad.
Place hot sauce and oil in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce.
When the wings are done, remove from the oven and add to the bowl with the sauce. Toss to coat.
To serve, divide hot wings and salad between plates. Serve with additional dressing on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
